title: Surreal Pig Nightmare
description: A large pink pig with a human male face lies on the ground in a field at night, its body transforming into a giant centipede with a segmented brown exoskeleton and many pink legs. A small girl in a blue nightgown climbs on its head while a glowing yellow crescent moon with a black cat silhouette floats above.
prompt: Surreal night scene featuring a giant pink pig with a realistic human man's face lying in a field, its body morphing into a long segmented centipede with many pink legs. A small girl in a blue floral nightgown is climbing on the pig's head. A glowing yellow crescent moon with a black cat silhouette sits above them against a purple starry sky with clouds and wooden fences in the background, purple thistle flowers in the foreground.
